programme.title: The Watchers

Shaken to the core, Whip vows to get sober -- but when the crash investigation exposes his addiction, he finds himself in an even worse situation.

programme.title: Possession

However, greedy park owner Dial soon catches wind of the duo and makes plans to profit from them.
